name: Miscellaneous Fee.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
This covers most of small charges in an order.
PVC mask
MoQ: 300pcs, unit price: 1usd/pc
Examples are:
An order less than 300pcs, lets say 50pcs
50pcs will be consumed and 250pcs are left at the moment(Either ship them together with the purchased items or keep them in our warehouse for next orders)
An order over 300pcs, lets say 350pcs
Then we could order an exact amount 350pcs for this order.
There will be none left.
COO(country of origin)
15usd/EACH copy
Customer needs to go through the content, it is non-modifiable once confirmed.
This has to be exercised AT LEAST 2 working days before shipment.
Please let us know how we handle the copy(attach it on the outside or put it inside the box).
Transaction Cost
25usd for EACH T/T transfer whatever the invoice value is.
5usd for every 100usd to PayPal a/c, this ratio is standard charge by PayPal
It is standard charge in EACH order.
